resources.string: 30 Days of recipes
"Day %d"
Classic Syrniki (Cheese Pancakes)
Tender cottage cheese pancakes that melt in your mouth. The perfect breakfast for the whole family.

Mix 300 g of cottage cheese with 1 egg, 1 tbsp of sugar and a pinch of salt. Add 2 tbsp of flour, knead the dough. Form into patties, dredge in flour. Fry in vegetable oil for 2-3 minutes on each side. Serve with sour cream.
Hot Sandwiches
Crispy sandwiches with melted cheese — a quick snack that will save you in any situation.
Grate 100 g of boiled sausage and 80 g of hard cheese, mix with 2 tbsp of mayonnaise. Spread onto 4 slices of baguette. Bake for 10 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Fried Eggs in Bell Pepper
A bright and healthy dish that will decorate any breakfast. Fried eggs in an edible bowl.
Cut bell pepper into rings 1 cm thick. Fry the rings in a pan on both sides. Crack 1 egg into each ring, season with salt and pepper. Fry covered until done.
Banana Pancakes
Fluffy pancakes without sugar — the sweetness of ripe bananas makes them perfect for a healthy breakfast.
Mash 1 ripe banana with a fork, add 1 egg and 3 tbsp of flour, mix. Fry on a dry non-stick pan for 2 minutes on each side.
Rice Porridge with Apple
Milk porridge with apple and cinnamon — a cozy breakfast with the aroma of childhood.
Pour 200 ml of milk and 100 ml of water over 100 g of rice, cook for 15-20 minutes. Grate 1 apple, add to the porridge along with 0.5 tsp of cinnamon and honey to taste.
Cottage Cheese Casserole
Fluffy and tender casserole with raisins — just like in kindergarten. A great way to feed cottage cheese even to those who don\'t like it.
Mix 300 g of cottage cheese with 1 egg, 2 tbsp of semolina, 2 tbsp of sugar and 50 g of raisins. Put into a mold, spread 1 tbsp of sour cream on top. Bake for 25-30 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
French Toast
Golden toast for breakfast — simple, hearty and delicious. Crispy crust and tender center.
Whisk 2 eggs with 50 ml of milk and a pinch of salt. Dip 4 slices of baguette in the mixture. Fry in butter until golden brown.
Chicken Noodle Soup
Light and clear soup that will warm you up and give you strength. A classic of home cooking.

Boil 300 g of chicken fillet in 1.5 liters of water (20 minutes), chop the meat. Add 3 diced potatoes to the broth. Grate 1 carrot, chop 1 onion, sauté, add to the soup. After 10 minutes, add 50 g of vermicelli, return the chicken, cook for 5 minutes. Add herbs, salt, pepper.
Tuna Salad
A simple and hearty salad made with canned tuna — an ideal option for a quick lunch.
Dice 2 hard-boiled eggs. Mash 1 can of tuna with a fork. Add 100 g of canned corn and a bunch of green onions. Dress with 2 tbsp of mayonnaise, add salt.
Greek Salad
A juicy and bright salad with fresh vegetables and tender feta cheese. A taste of the Mediterranean on your table.
Coarsely chop 1 cucumber, 2 tomatoes, 1 bell pepper, half a red onion. Add 150 g of feta cheese (cubed) and 10-12 olives. Dress with 3 tbsp of olive oil, salt, pepper, sprinkle with oregano.
Cheese Soup
A creamy and flavorful soup with processed cheese — a real cream soup in no time.

Add 3 diced potatoes to 1.5 liters of boiling water. Sauté 1 grated carrot and 1 chopped onion, add to the soup. When the potatoes are cooked, add 2 processed cheese slices (200 g), cut into cubes. Stir until dissolved. Add salt, pepper, herbs.
Chicken Salad with Croutons
A crunchy salad with tender chicken — a great alternative to restaurant Caesar at home.

Fry 200 g of chicken fillet and dice it. Tear a bunch of lettuce, halve 150 g of cherry tomatoes. For the sauce, mix 2 tbsp of mayonnaise with 1 clove of garlic (minced) and 1 tsp of lemon juice. Mix chicken, lettuce, tomatoes and 50 g of croutons, dress with the sauce.
Pea Soup
A hearty and rich soup with a smoky aroma. A favorite dish for the cold season.

Soak 200 g of peas overnight. Boil 300 g of meat (pork or chicken) in 2 liters of water until done. Add peas, cook for 30-40 minutes. Add 3 diced potatoes. Sauté 1 carrot and 1 onion, add to the soup. Cook until potatoes are tender. Add salt and pepper.
Crab Stick Salad
A classic salad that everyone loves. Tender, juicy and very easy to prepare.
Chop 200 g of crab sticks, add 2 diced hard-boiled eggs, 100 g of canned corn, 1 fresh cucumber (diced) and green onions. Dress with mayonnaise.
Navy-Style Pasta
A hearty and quick dish from childhood. Pasta with ground meat — simple and delicious.
Boil 300 g of pasta. Fry 300 g of minced meat with 1 onion, season with salt and pepper. Mix the minced meat with pasta and heat for 2 minutes.
Oven-Baked Chicken Legs
Rosy and juicy chicken legs with a crispy crust. A simple dinner without any hassle.
Rub 4 chicken drumsticks with salt, pepper, paprika and coat with sour cream (2 tbsp). Bake for 30-40 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
Potato and Minced Meat Casserole
A hearty casserole with a cheese crust — a complete dinner for the whole family.

Slice 4-5 potatoes thinly. Fry 300 g of minced meat with onion. Layer in a mold: potatoes, minced meat, potatoes. Pour over a mixture of 1 egg and 100 ml of milk, sprinkle with 100 g of grated cheese. Bake for 40 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Draniki (Potato Pancakes)
Crispy potato pancakes with a golden crust. Serve with sour cream — finger-licking good!
Grate 4 potatoes and 1 onion on a fine grater, add 1 egg, 1 tbsp of flour, salt. Spoon the mixture onto a pan with vegetable oil and fry on both sides until golden brown. Serve with sour cream.
Fish in Foil
Tender and juicy fish fillet baked in its own juices. A healthy dinner in 20 minutes.
Season 300 g of any fish fillet with salt, pepper, sprinkle with lemon juice. Top with a piece of butter and dill. Wrap in foil, bake for 20-25 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
Vegetable Stew
A light and juicy vegetable stew — an ideal side dish or a standalone dish for vegetarians.
Sauté 1 onion and 1 carrot. Add diced 2 potatoes, 1 zucchini, 1 eggplant, 1 bell pepper. Add 2 tbsp of tomato paste, salt, pepper, simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Lazy Cabbage Rolls
The taste of classic cabbage rolls without the hassle of cabbage leaves. Quick, hearty, homestyle.

Mix 300 g of minced meat, 100 g of cooked rice, 1 finely chopped onion, salt, pepper. Form into patties, fry on both sides. Place in a pot, pour over a mixture of 2 tbsp of sour cream, 1 tbsp of tomato paste and 200 ml of water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Apple Charlotte
A fluffy and aromatic apple pie that everyone can make. The perfect dessert for tea.
Beat 3 eggs with a glass of sugar, add a glass of flour, mix. Slice 3 apples, place in a mold, pour over the batter. Bake for 30-40 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Lavash with Cheese
A crispy lavash roll with melted cheese inside. Cooks faster than a sandwich.
Sprinkle thin lavash (flatbread) with 150 g of grated cheese and chopped herbs, roll up. Fry in a pan on both sides until the cheese melts.
Cottage Cheese Triangles
Tender shortbread cookies with cottage cheese — a favorite treat from childhood. Sprinkled with sugar, they melt in your mouth.

Knead dough from 200 g of cottage cheese, 100 g of soft butter, 1 cup of flour, 1 tsp of baking powder and a pinch of salt. Roll out, cut into circles, sprinkle with sugar, fold in half and then in half again (triangle). Bake for 20 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Apples with Cottage Cheese
Baked apples with cottage cheese filling — a healthy and light dessert without excess sugar.
Cut off the tops of 3 apples, remove the core. Mix 150 g of cottage cheese with 1 tbsp of honey or sugar, stuff the apples. Bake for 20 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Pizza on Ready-Made Dough
Homemade pizza in 20 minutes — take ready-made dough and any toppings. Better than delivery.
Roll out ready-made yeast dough, spread with tomato paste (2 tbsp). Add toppings: sausage, mushrooms, pepper, olives. Sprinkle with 150 g of grated cheese. Bake for 15-20 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
Homemade Nuggets
Crispy chicken pieces that kids love. A homemade version of popular fast food.
Cut 300 g of chicken fillet into small pieces. Dredge in flour, then in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Country-Style Potatoes
Potato wedges with aromatic spices — a great alternative to french fries.

Wash 5-6 potatoes thoroughly, cut into wedges (do not peel). Mix with 2 tbsp of vegetable oil, salt, pepper, paprika (1 tsp) and minced garlic (2 cloves). Place on a baking sheet, bake for 30-40 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
Overnight Oats in a Jar
Breakfast that cooks itself while you sleep. Healthy oats with berries from the fridge.
Put 4 tbsp of rolled oats into a jar, pour in 100 ml of milk, add 1 tsp of honey and a handful of berries. Close the lid and refrigerate overnight.
Homemade Lemonade
A refreshing drink with citrus flavor and mint. Better than any store-bought.
In a pitcher, mix the juice of 2 lemons, 4 tbsp of sugar (or honey), a handful of mint. Pour in 1 liter of sparkling water, add ice and lemon slices.
